scope: Before/after diagnostics for the tile/column position handoff patch. Each run uses six uninterrupted alternating swaps; these delivery timings do not measure retarget smoothness or physical presentation.

before.scope: Nested winit capture delivery intervals without fixed-rate resampling, plus IPC acknowledgement latency. Includes host compositor, screencopy and encoder scheduling. Does not measure GPU draw time, input latency, physical scanout or dropped presentation frames.

after.scope: Nested winit capture delivery intervals without fixed-rate resampling, plus IPC acknowledgement latency. Includes host compositor, screencopy and encoder scheduling. Does not measure GPU draw time, input latency, physical scanout or dropped presentation frames.
